_meta.purpose: Citable relational-layer inputs for the T3 exposure/response tier. Every value is sourced from a named external dataset (COW NMC/CINC, ATOP/COW alliances, ICOW, COW MID, WDI). See docs/relational_tier_spec.md.
_meta.discipline: The EXPOSURE axis (E1-E5) is strictly citable external data - that is the new contribution and must stay clean. The internal_pillars block is the MI's internal read (P1/P5); for historical cases (no contemporaneous WGI) it is the same recorded ordinal estimate the corpus already uses, tagged accordingly - it is NOT part of the citable exposure layer.
_meta.provenance_tiers: Three tiers, decreasing confidence: (1) CITABLE - COW NMC/CINC, ATOP/COW alliances, ICOW, SIPRI (>=1816 / >=1949); this file. (2) HISTORICAL-PROXY - established quantitative historical series (Maddison GDP, V-Dem rule-of-law) used as era-appropriate proxies where the citable relational primitives don't exist pre-1816; historical_proxy_inputs.json. (3) INTERPRETED - pure hindsight, no structured source (the ancient tier's domain). This file is tier 1 only.
_meta.e1_method: Tier 1 uses method='cinc' (COW composite capability ratio). Tier 2 uses method='economic_mass' (Maddison GDPpc x population ratio) because CINC doesn't exist pre-1816.

Cyprus@1974.label: Republic of Cyprus, pre-invasion 1974 (the documented exogenous MISS)

internal_pillars.provenance: historical ordinal estimate (corpus convention; no 1974 WGI). Divided bicommunal republic: moderate state institutions, low stability (intercommunal violence 1963-64, 1967). INTERNAL READ ONLY - not part of the citable exposure layer.

E2_patron.detail: 1960 Treaty of Guarantee (Greece/Turkey/UK). Structurally non-credible: Turkey was itself a guarantor (the 'intervention' clause it invoked); the Greek junta did not/ could not project force; the UK declined to act. No defender honored it.
E2_patron.provenance: ATOP 4.0 / Treaty of Guarantee (1960) text + historical record of non-intervention

E3_contested_border.detail: Active irredentist/protection claim: enosis (union w/ Greece) vs taksim (partition); Turkey asserted a right to protect the Turkish-Cypriot community.

E5_great_power_faultline.detail: NATO southern flank, Cold War Eastern Mediterranean.

Cyprus@1974.outcome_factual: Turkish invasion (Jul-Aug 1974); ~37% of the island occupied; de facto partition persisting to today.

South Korea@2016.label: Republic of Korea (the patron-SHIELDED mirror)

internal_pillars.provenance: LIVE from the Data API (modern unit, scoreable). Nulls here are placeholders; the module reads P1/P5 from score_country at run time.

E1_relative_power.provenance: COW NMC v6 (CINC), 2016. Adversary = most-capable plausible intervener in a peninsular war (the 1950 precedent), not the proximate DPRK.

E2_patron.detail: US-ROK Mutual Defense Treaty (1953), ATOP-coded, with ~28k forward-deployed US forces and demonstrated reinforcement posture.

E3_contested_border.detail: DPRK constitutional claim to the whole peninsula; armistice (1953), not a peace treaty.

E4_neighborhood.detail: Recurrent DPRK militarized provocations along the DMZ/NLL.

E5_great_power_faultline.detail: US-China strategic boundary in Northeast Asia.

South Korea@2016.outcome_factual: Persists as a sovereign state under standing high exposure; no successful invasion since 1953.
